Do these providers sell a hosted compute sandbox or hosted compute capacity? For each, add a record with its price, free tier and identity cost, or record why it is not an offer.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/quave-one-agent-sandboxes-direct $.verdict: The page shows pay-per-use only, no free allowance, and sandboxes are enabled per account on request. The verification page does not say sandboxes run on the no-card Hobby region, so nothing shows a route that would make this qualifies-with-caveat rather than paid-only.
- compute/quave-one-agent-sandboxes-direct $.identity_cost.kind: Only a route name in a script on the access page (Meteor app, no rendered sign-up text); no capture states the sign-up method. Google and GitHub OAuth packages also load.
- compute/anona-compute $.identity_cost.kind: No capture says the sign-up identity is an email; sources say only 'browser sign-in' and 'Sign in to the dashboard'. A fresh read of compute.anonalabs.com hit a login wall (409 from the broker).
